project_title: Webflow Expert Needed for Simple SaaS Landing Page (Fast Turnaround)

project_metadata.job_title: Webflow Expert Needed for Simple SaaS Landing Page (Fast Turnaround)
project_metadata.job_description:
I’m looking for an experienced Webflow expert to build a clean, modern landing page for a B2B SaaS product.

This is not a large website. The primary goal is to launch a professional public-facing website as quickly as possible to satisfy Apple Developer requirements.

Project Scope

* Build a modern one-page landing page in Webflow
* Use the most cost-effective Webflow plan
* Mobile responsive
* Add a contact/early access form
* Add a Login button (URL will be provided)
* Include a Privacy Policy and Contact page (or section)
* Assist with connecting our custom domain

I’ll Provide

* All website copy
* Logo
* App screenshots
* Brand colours

No copywriting or branding work is required.

Looking For

* Proven Webflow experience
* Clean, modern SaaS design style
* Excellent communication
* Ability to start immediately
* Ability to deliver within a few days

Future Opportunity

This is Phase 1 of a larger project. If we’re a good fit, there will be additional paid work after launch, including expanding the website, adding a blog, new pages, and ongoing improvements.

When applying, please include:

* 2 to 5 Webflow websites you’ve built
* Your estimated turnaround time
* Why you’re a good fit for this project

I’m ready to hire immediately and would like to get started as soon as possible.

Good news: [URL_021] is online again. I've restored the DNS records, and the site is now serving as normal.

There is one remaining issue with [URL_026]. Although the DNS is correctly directed to Firebase, the domain was removed from the Firebase Hosting configuration, which is why a "Site Not Found" page appears. Since I don't have access to Firebase, I can't add it again, but you can quickly resolve it on your side:

1\. Open the LotClip project at [URL_027]
2\. Select Hosting from the left menu
3\. Locate the lotclip-main site, then click "Add custom domain"
4\. Enter: [URL_026]
5\. Select the option that redirects it to an existing site, then choose [URL_021]
6\. Continue through the remaining steps to finish — all requested DNS records are already set up, so you only need to confirm them

Afterward, the SSL certificate will take a few hours to be issued, so www might display a warning until that process finishes. No other changes are required.

Once you've added it, let me know and I'll check that it resolves properly.
